svg.title: Virtual photon exchange between two charges
svg.desc: (a) Four snapshots of two positive charges. The left charge emits a photon and recoils to the left; the photon travels to the right charge, which then recoils to the right, so the charges repel. (b) If an eye intercepts the photon on its way, the photon is absorbed by the eye and never reaches the second charge, so the force is not transmitted: the exchanged photon cannot be observed without disrupting it.
